description.value: The Stewart Museum, operated by the Stewart Historical Society, preserves the history of Stewart, one of BC's most remote communities near the Alaska-BC border. Exhibits include a new avalanche display and extensive coverage of the region's mining heritage, offering touring cyclists a window into the rugged pioneer history of the area. The museum also houses archives and a gift shop featuring Canadian-made goods and historical literature.
